result.brief: 提出结构条件视频渲染器 SolarRenderer，用冻结视频骨干加双 LoRA 与四步分布匹配，实现快速、可泛化到多种结构表示的可控视频生成。
result.reason: Structure-conditioned video renderer built on a frozen video backbone with LoRA control and few-step distribution matching; contributes to controllable video generation and video world-model rendering.
